scope: N83 a=0 D18 full-Gauss positive and first natural export 2026-11-14
statement: On the frozen ordered D18 constructed positive XCNF, one-thread CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 with 32 Gaussian matrices returned SAT in 2.0425195 seconds and its assignment passed original XCNF plus curve and relation-row replay; the first public-target natural XCNF exported successfully and its solver was withheld by the host-load gate
